data.description: The Halloween season in Rust brings spooky atmosphere and exciting challenges to the game. With scary NPCs and rewards, this event leaves no room for boredom. Whether you're collecting candy, exploring portals, or showing the scarecrows who's boss – there's something for everyone in the Halloween event.
